faces.transcription: Sometimes there will be text at the end of the paragraph that gives further instructions. In this case, there is no further information.
faces.flavor: You picked up traces of Sabik, but nothing definitive. A few locals indicated that they saw someone matching his description, but the individual was bundled up. You can't determine at the moment why he hasn't come in or made contact.
